name: Baden 2016 RGC direction-selective subset
short_description: Per-cell functional fingerprints (chirp, moving-bar, colour, RF) and metadata for 1,238 cells from the 8 paper-authoritative direction-selective groups of Baden et al. 2016. No morphologies — Baden 2016 is a functional dataset.
size_description: 1238 retinal ganglion / displaced amacrine cells from the 8 paper-authoritative DS-containing groups (G2/G6/G12/G13/G16/G25/G26/G29) of Baden 2016, one row per cell with functional traces (chirp 249 samples, moving-bar 32 samples, moving-bar by 8 directions 256 samples, colour 96 samples, RF temporal kernel 80 samples) and per-cell selectivity indices, soma area/volume, RF Gaussian fit, immuno (ChAT, GAD, melanopsin, SMI-32) and genetics (PV, PCP2) flags. NO per-cell IPL stratification depth and NO morphology in the Dryad release.

files.description: Per-cell Parquet table for the 8 DS groups. One row per cell; functional traces stored as nested list<float32> columns (scalar feature columns retain native precision). Stimulus time axes and the moving-bar direction-major layout are recorded in the Parquet file-level key/value metadata under key `baden_2016_ds_cells_metadata`.
